title: Moon Microbes Could Hijack Future Lunar Bases

scenes.text: Apollo 12 soil samples contained hardy Bacillus spores that survived lunar vacuum
Bacillus subtilis formed resilient endospores that stayed viable after 3 days of exposure to space vacuum and UV
These microbes could contaminate habitats and affect life‑support systems
